scripts.build:contracts: bun run --filter @graveshift/core build && bun run --filter @graveshift/events build
scripts.typecheck: bun check --no-script apps/api apps/daemon/src/platform.database.test.ts apps/daemon/src/platform.fixture.ts apps/daemon/src/platform-http.fixture.ts apps/daemon/src/command-handler.test.ts apps/daemon/src/fix-audit.test.ts apps/daemon/src/observations.test.ts apps/daemon/src/observations.pending.test.ts apps/daemon/src/reads.test.ts apps/daemon/src/transport.test.ts apps/daemon/src/flow.fixture.ts apps/daemon/src/lease.test.ts apps/daemon/src/model-context.test.ts apps/daemon/src/observations-database.test.ts apps/daemon/src/publication-failure.test.ts apps/daemon/src/recovery.test.ts apps/daemon/src/work-activation.test.ts apps/daemon/src/work-flow.test.ts packages/api-contract/scripts/generate.ts --tsconfig-override apps/api/tsconfig.json && bun check --no-script && bun check --no-script -p apps/console
scripts.build: bun run build:contracts && bun build apps/daemon/src/main.ts --target=bun --outdir=node_modules/.cache/graveshift-build/daemon && bun build packages/actuator/src/main.ts --target=bun --outdir=node_modules/.cache/graveshift-build/actuator && bun run build:console
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:check && bun run test
